role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for a deterministic solver-native measurement-Krylov-complement linear-heat correction. It is not a rerun or tolerance relaxation of v257, an active-support mask, scalar endpoint blend, cross-frame/global low-rank repair, graph-diffusion parameter search, learned model, or truth-selected correction.
scientific_question: Can the portion of the fixed linear-heat correction that lies outside the already measured K13 Krylov span preserve the field and gradient repair seen in v250 while avoiding its K16-matched observation harm, followed by one unchanged full-field PCGLS step and fewer exact calls than K16?
physical_hypothesis: K13 has already fitted the observation components carried by its thirteen solver directions. The equal-call linear-heat endpoint repairs the under-regularized field but disturbs those fitted components. Removing the complete measurement-normal projection of the heat correction onto the current K13 directions preserves only a solver-native complementary correction before one exact restarted step.
design_evidence_boundary: Case 19 and v244-v257 are already open and may motivate this post-open diagnostic. No v258 Case 19 field, correction projection, coefficient, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol, core, runner, validator and tests are committed. Synthetic unit tests do not read Case 19.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v248 frame-zero parser, float64 rectilinear interpolation, one-voxel truth support and active-cell truth gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters K13, heat diffusion, Krylov complement, coefficients, controls, depth or stopping.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_linear_heat_measurement_krylov_complement_restart_pcgls_k1
unique_primary.base: Run zero-start reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS K13 and retain all thirteen field search directions p_i and exact projected directions A p_i in iteration order.
unique_primary.raw_heat_correction: Apply the already frozen v250 linear six-neighbour heat map to x13: 16,604 active-active edges, simultaneous explicit flux, tau=1/12, twelve steps, one-voxel zero support and active-cell mean gauge. Set d=heat(x13)-x13 and compute exactly one A d.
unique_primary.complete_normal_projection: Let P=[p_i], Q=[A p_i], G=Q^T Q and b=Q^T A d. Scale G to its unit-diagonal correlation matrix. Use a complete float64 symmetric eigensolve with no rank truncation, no coefficient clipping and no ridge. If min_eigenvalue <= 1e-12*max_eigenvalue, execution is invalid. Solve G beta=b and set d_perp=d-P beta and A d_perp=A d-Q beta.
unique_primary.warm_initializer: Set x_warm=x13+d_perp and use the cached projection y-r13+A d_perp. Then run exactly one unchanged full-field reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS iteration. No fallback or early stopping.
unique_primary.ledger: K13 costs 13A+13A^T; A d costs 1A; cached-projection restarted PCGLS K1 costs 1A+1A^T.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_linear_heat_restart_pcgls_k1
controls.definition: Frozen v250 deterministic linear-heat endpoint and identical restarted K1 shell without the Krylov-complement projection.

forbidden_search: No Krylov depth, retained rank, eigenvalue floor, ridge, pseudoinverse, direction weighting, heat graph, boundary, step size/count, diffusion time, blend, correction multiplier, final depth, preconditioner, camera subset, rig, metric, threshold or fallback search is allowed after freeze. Do not reuse v257 arrays or alter its tolerances.

accuracy_gate.two_replica_envelope: For every arm, rig and metric take max(formal_metric, independent_metric) before any absolute, matched, tail or control decision. Passing therefore requires both numerical implementations to pass every gate.
accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If the equal-call frozen linear-heat control or cheaper K14 control passes all thirteen absolute and K16-matched envelope cells, Krylov-complement-specific headroom is not isolated.

independent_validation.method: A second program must rebuild observations and Jacobi, independently implement the K13 recurrence, scalar-loop linear heat map, full correlation system and Cholesky solve, cached-projection restart, controls, physical replay, metrics and calls without importing the formal v258 core. It seals predictions before reading formal scientific arrays.
independent_validation.adjudication: Continuous cross-implementation differences are reported and bounded, but the scientific decision uses the componentwise worst-case metric envelope rather than exact floating equality. This is prospective and more conservative than choosing either implementation.

decision_order: Any source, input, shape, finite, full-rank, heat, normal-equation, complement-orthogonality, projection reconstruction, permutation, call-ledger, replay, seal or prospective cross-implementation closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_KRYLOV_COMPLEMENT_HEAT_FRAME_ZERO_V258.

If the unique primary fails any of the thirteen absolute or K16-matched worst-case-envelope cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_KRYLOV_COMPLEMENT_HEAT_FRAME_ZERO_V258 and close this complete-K13-complement mechanism without a full sequence run.

If the primary passes all thirteen but the equal-call linear-heat or cheaper K14 control also passes all thirteen envelope cells, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_KRYLOV_COMPLEMENT_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V258.

Only if the primary passes 13/13 absolute and matched envelope cells, both controls remain incomplete, every ledger and independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_KRYLOV_COMPLEMENT_HEAT_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V258 and authorize one separately frozen 429-cell sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the complete K13 measurement-Krylov-complement linear-heat correction without changing rank, solver, floor, heat map, depth, controls or thresholds. Do not rescue with support masks, endpoint blending, rank search, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.
